title: 3D Spinning Dice Animation using HTML & CSS 🎲✨
description: Want to create a realistic 3D dice animation with just HTML & CSS? 🎲🚀 In this tutorial, we build a spinning dice that smoothly rotates along the Y-axis, giving it an immersive 3D effect. Using CSS Grid, keyframe animations, and lighting effects, this project simulates a rolling die with all six sides beautifully designed!
